Verifier Toolkit

one-core (VP Engine)
one-core (VP Engine)
ETDA Trusted List (CDN)
ETDA Trusted List (CDN)
[SPEC] Verifier Officer = staff of the verifier agency using the Verifier Toolkit
sections 1 to 4 : the officer requests a verification and shows the QR
[CONDITION] before this flow : the verifier setup is done (VP part 0)
verifier key and DID , listed in ver.txt , issuer schema imported , verification template created
0.1 Load ETDA Trusted Lists (when a transaction needs them)
[SPEC] steps in the ETDA Trusted List Load sequence (first tab)
VCVP Core also loads ver.txt for its own verifier check in section 2
[STANDARD] Thai VC ARF 2.0 DRAFT 0
• appendix 8.2 E.1.1 (MUST) the verifier fetches iss.txt and wp.txt
[SPEC] Trusted List not usable (TRUST_LIST_EXPIRED / TRUST_LIST_UNAVAILABLE) : the calling step answers 503 Service Unavailable + Retry-After: 300
not the trust failure reason of that step , as in the ETDA Trusted List Load sequence
1. Verifier requests a verification
Request verification
credential , requested claims ex : LicenseNumber , FullNameTH , purpose
2. VCVP Core validates the verifier before creating a proof request
Create verification + Consumer-Key + Token | POST /api/proof-request/v1 (VCVP Core 24)
verification_template_id , verifier_identity_id , purpose (code , legal_basis , consent_ref optional) , callback_url (optional)
Check Consumer-Key and Token , validate caller authorization
Check Purpose.Code is in the Purpose.Code list and callback_url (when sent) is https , otherwise 400 FailureReason = REQUEST_REJECTED
[STANDARD] PDPA B.E. 2562
• section 19 consent is obtained before or at the time of collection
[SPEC] the holder gives consent in the wallet when presenting (VP part 2 , section 4) , DW keeps the sharing record
ConsentRef = optional reference of a consent the verifier agency keeps itself , stored when sent , not checked
[STANDARD] RFC 9110
• 15.5.2 (MUST) 401 when the request has no valid credentials , with WWW-Authenticate
• 15.5.4 403 when the caller is known but not allowed
Resolve the verification template (VerificationTemplates) , not found 403 FailureReason = TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND
and the verifier identity (VerifierIdentityId) with its ACTIVE SIGNING key as verifierKey (Keys : KeyUsage = SIGNING , Status = ACTIVE) , not found 403 FailureReason = VERIFIER_DID_NOT_FOUND
both of the caller organisation , another organisation 403 FailureReason = CALLER_NOT_AUTHORIZED
[STANDARD] Thai VC ARF 2.0 DRAFT 0
• 9.8 (MUST) identity , key , status , validity period and scope checked from the Trusted List
• 12.2.1 (MUST) the verifier entry is in the Trusted List
• 8.4.1 step 3 (MUST) verifier service found by ServiceTypeIdentifier and key , organisation and service status active
[SPEC] service type = verifier , organisation and service status = active , validity period current , the verifier public key is listed , purpose within the allowed purposes
This check before creating a request is a VCVP policy , the wallet checks the verifier itself (VP part 2 , section 1.2 , TC-1)
Look up the verifier in the cached Verifier Trusted List (ver.txt , ETDA Trusted List Load)
service type = verifier (ServiceTypeIdentifier) , verifier DID and key listed , organisation and service status = active , validity period current , purpose allowed
[AUDIT LOG] VCVPAuditLog (TrustCheck)
result stored in TrustCheck.Result , timestamp in TrustCheck.CheckedAt
Trusted List reference (LoTESequenceNumber , entity id) in TrustCheck.RegistryReference
alt
[Consumer-Key or Token invalid or missing]
[ERROR AUDIT] Write audit record of VCVP Core 24 (FailureReason = CALLER_NOT_AUTHENTICATED , OrgCode and Actor empty)
401 + WWW-Authenticate | failure_reason = CALLER_NOT_AUTHENTICATED
Show error , verification not created
[Purpose.Code not in the Purpose.Code list or callback_url not https]
[ERROR AUDIT] Write audit record of VCVP Core 24 (FailureReason = REQUEST_REJECTED)
400 | failure_reason = REQUEST_REJECTED
Show error , verification not created
[Template or verifier identity not found , verifier not authorized or not in the Verifier Trusted List]
Request rejected before creating a proof request
[ERROR AUDIT] Write audit record of VCVP Core 24
(FailureReason = TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND / CALLER_NOT_AUTHORIZED / VERIFIER_DID_NOT_FOUND / VERIFIER_NOT_TRUSTED , TrustCheck)
403 | failure_reason = TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND / CALLER_NOT_AUTHORIZED / VERIFIER_DID_NOT_FOUND / VERIFIER_NOT_TRUSTED
Reject request
Unauthorized / Not trusted / Insufficient permission
[Trusted List not usable]
[ERROR AUDIT] Write audit record of VCVP Core 24 (FailureReason = TRUST_LIST_EXPIRED / TRUST_LIST_UNAVAILABLE)
503 + Retry-After | failure_reason = TRUST_LIST_EXPIRED / TRUST_LIST_UNAVAILABLE
Show error , try again later
[Verifier authorized and trusted]
Check verifierKey (Keys.ExpiryDate)
alt
[verifierKey expired (Keys.ExpiryDate passed)]
[SPEC] the expired key becomes DEPRECATED in every case below , a switched key signs new request objects
Mark the expired key as DEPRECATED (Keys.Status)
[STANDARD] Thai VC ARF 2.0 DRAFT 0
• 12.2.1 (MUST) verifier public key in the Verifier Trusted List entry or a did:web DID document at /.well-known/did.json
Find a reserved SIGNING key of the verifier identity (KeyUsage = SIGNING , Status = RESERVED , IssueDate reached)
listed for the verifier in the cached Verifier Trusted List (ver.txt , ETDA Trusted List Load) , take the oldest IssueDate (same date : oldest CreatedAt)
alt
[A reserved SIGNING key is usable (listed in ver.txt , IssueDate reached)]
[SPEC] the reserved key is already in the DID (added when the DID was created , VCVP Core 03)
VCVP policy : the switch updates the DID , the old key leaves authentication and stays in assertionMethod when it is there
Switch verifierKey to the selected reserved key
(Keys.Status RESERVED → ACTIVE)
Update the DID keys | PATCH /api/identifier/v1/{id}
did.keys
[Reserved SIGNING keys left , none usable yet (not listed in ver.txt or IssueDate not reached)]
[ERROR AUDIT] Write audit record of VCVP Core 24 (FailureReason = VERIFIER_KEY_NOT_LISTED)
409 | failure_reason = VERIFIER_KEY_NOT_LISTED
Show error , verification not created
Verification not created , sections 3 and 4 do not apply
[No reserved SIGNING key left]
[SPEC] no key is created during the request , the organisation creates a SIGNING key (VCVP Core 02) and adds it to the DID (VCVP Core 40)
[ERROR AUDIT] Write audit record of VCVP Core 24 (FailureReason = VERIFIER_KEY_EXPIRED)
409 | failure_reason = VERIFIER_KEY_EXPIRED
Show error , verification not created
Verification not created , sections 3 and 4 do not apply
[Key active]
Continue
3. VCVP Core creates the proof request
[SPEC] webhookDestinationUrl is sent on every request , the engine calls VCVP Core 30 when the result is ready
then VCVP Core calls Verifications.CallbackUrl when it has a value , null : the Verifier Toolkit asks for the result at VCVP Core 32 (VP part 2 , section 9)
VCVP policy : a new random secret for each request , VCVP Core keeps only its hash
Create the webhook secret (32 random bytes)
webhookDestinationUrl = URL of VCVP Core 30 + ?webhook_token={secret}
Create verification request | POST /api/proof-request/v1
proofSchemaId , protocol , verifier , verifierKey , webhookDestinationUrl
{ id } = VerificationId (state CREATED)
[STANDARD] PDPA B.E. 2562
• section 39 record of processing activities , including the purpose
[SPEC] purpose and legal basis are recorded when the request is created and cannot be added later
[DATA STORE] Store Verifications table

VerificationId = id from the engine , Purpose (Code , LegalBasis , ConsentRef when sent) , WebhookSecretHash (sha256 of the secret) , CallbackUrl (callback_url , null when not sent) , Status = PENDING
[AUDIT LOG] Write audit record of VCVP Core 24 : who requested which verification and for which purpose
(Purpose.Code , Purpose.LegalBasis , Purpose.ConsentRef , TrustCheck , EngineCalls , Correlation.VerificationId)
200 | verification_id
4. Generate the verification link
Request verification link + Consumer-Key + Token | POST /api/proof-request/v1/{verification_id}/share (VCVP Core 25)
Check Consumer-Key and Token , validate caller authorization
alt
[Consumer-Key or Token invalid or missing]
[ERROR AUDIT] Write audit record of VCVP Core 25 (FailureReason = CALLER_NOT_AUTHENTICATED , OrgCode and Actor empty)
401 + WWW-Authenticate | failure_reason = CALLER_NOT_AUTHENTICATED
Show error , no verification link
[Caller not authorized]
[ERROR AUDIT] Write audit record of VCVP Core 25 (FailureReason = CALLER_NOT_AUTHORIZED)
403 | failure_reason = CALLER_NOT_AUTHORIZED
Show error , no verification link
[Caller authorized]
Find VerificationId in Verifications table , not found 403 FailureReason = VERIFICATION_NOT_FOUND
another organisation 403 FailureReason = CALLER_NOT_AUTHORIZED
[STANDARD] OpenID4VP 1.0
• 5.9.3 (MUST) decentralized_identifier , the request object is signed with a key of the verifier DID
[STANDARD] Thai VC ARF 2.0 DRAFT 0
• appendix 8.2 E.1.5 (MUST) TC-1 , the wallet finds the verifier public key in the Verifier Trusted List
• 8.1.2 (MUST) client identifier prefix from OpenID4VP , decentralized_identifier allowed
• 12.7 x509_san_dns listed for verifiers in the Trusted List
• chapter 14 SC-09 the wallet enforces the client_id prefix
• 12.2.1 (MUST NOT) no redirect_uri client_id without a DID
[SPEC] verifier trust comes from ver.txt , not from a verifier attestation signed by the engine itself
[ENGINE RULE] share works only when the state is CREATED , PENDING or INTERACTION_EXPIRED , other states get 400 BR_0013
a new share replaces the interaction , the previous link stops working
Generate verification link | POST /api/proof-request/v1/{id}/share
body { "params" : { "clientIdScheme" : "decentralized_identifier" } }
alt
[Link created]
url , expiresAt , state
[DATA STORE] Store OfferUrl + ExpiresAt in Verifications table , Status = PENDING
[AUDIT LOG] Write audit record of VCVP Core 25 : who created the verification link (EngineCalls , Correlation.VerificationId)
200 | offer_url , expires_at
[STANDARD] Thai VC ARF 2.0 DRAFT 0
• appendix 8.2 E.1.2 , E.1.3 , E.1.4 the QR carries request_uri , the wallet fetches the full request object (cross-device)
Show QR code (cross-device) or deep link (same device)
the holder scans the QR next (VP part 2 , section 1)
[State not CREATED / PENDING / INTERACTION_EXPIRED]
[ERROR AUDIT] Write audit record of VCVP Core 25 (FailureReason = VERIFICATION_NOT_SHAREABLE , EngineCalls , Correlation.VerificationId)
409 | failure_reason = VERIFICATION_NOT_SHAREABLE
Show error , create a new verification (section 2)
